"""Archive selected-source proof and verify the full original main ledger prefix."""
import gzip
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
P = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = P.parents[1]
OUT = ROOT / 'docs/friendly-command-gena-main-merge-preservation-proof-archive.json'
assert not OUT.exists()
sha = lambda b: hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
before_raw = (P / 'friendly-command-gena-main-before-merge.json').read_bytes()
before = json.loads(before_raw)
selected = json.loads((P / 'friendly-command-gena-promoted-portable-selected-source.json').read_bytes())
assert selected['state'] == 'passed' and selected['controls'] == 46
assert all(selected[k] for k in ['source_unchanged', 'head_unchanged', 'index_unchanged', 'protected_binaries_unchanged'])
assert selected['head'] == before['gena_head']
def old(label, name):
    row = before['files'][label + ':' + name]
    packed = Path(row['path']).read_bytes()
    assert sha(packed) == row['archive_sha256']
    raw = gzip.decompress(packed)
    assert sha(raw) == row['source_sha256'] and len(raw) == row['bytes']
    return raw
ledger = json.loads((ROOT / 'tests/fixtures/validity.json').read_bytes())
prior = json.loads(old('main', 'tests/fixtures/validity.json'))
gena = json.loads(old('gena', 'tests/fixtures/validity.json'))
assert ledger == gena and ledger['cases'][:35740] == prior['cases'] and len(ledger['cases']) == 35764
for key, value in prior.items():
    if key not in ['cases', 'sources']:
        assert ledger[key] == value
if isinstance(prior['sources'], list):
    assert ledger['sources'][:len(prior['sources'])] == prior['sources']
else:
    assert all(ledger['sources'][key] == value for key, value in prior['sources'].items())
reviews = json.loads((ROOT / 'docs/inventory-reviews.json').read_bytes())
prior_reviews = json.loads(old('main', 'docs/inventory-reviews.json'))
assert reviews == json.loads(old('gena', 'docs/inventory-reviews.json'))
assert len(reviews['entries']) == 520 and reviews['entries'][:519] == prior_reviews['entries']
assert {k:v for k,v in reviews.items() if k!='entries'} == {k:v for k,v in prior_reviews.items() if k!='entries'}
source_identity = {}
for name, profile in selected['profiles'].items():
    prefix = 'web/' if name == 'klem-web-assets' else ''
    for path, digest in profile['files'].items():
        assert sha((ROOT / (prefix + path)).read_bytes()) == digest, 'every actual main1146/1146/18 compiled input equals passed installed Gena'
    source_identity[name] = len(profile['files'])
checklist = (ROOT / 'docs/coverage-checklist.md').read_text()
assert checklist.count('**COV-017db ') == 1 and checklist.count('**COV-017cw ') == 1
old_main = old('main', 'docs/coverage-checklist.md').decode()
assert '[The complete promotion gate and current main merge proof]' in old_main and '[The complete promotion gate and current main merge proof]' in checklist
files = {}
paths = {Path(row['path']).name: Path(row['path']) for row in before['files'].values()}
for name in ['prepare_gena_main_merge.py', 'friendly-command-gena-main-before-merge.json',
             'verify_gena_portable_promoted_nix_source.py', 'friendly-command-gena-promoted-portable-selected-source.json',
             'friendly-command-gena-promoted-portable-selected-source.log', 'gena-promoted-portable-passed-before-inventory-queue.json.gz']:
    paths[name] = P / name
destination = ROOT / 'docs/friendly-command-gena-main-merge-preservation-proof'
destination.mkdir()
for name, path in sorted(paths.items()):
    raw = path.read_bytes(); packed = gzip.compress(raw, mtime=0)
    target = destination / (name + '.gz'); target.write_bytes(packed)
    assert gzip.decompress(target.read_bytes()) == raw
    files[name] = dict(path=str(target.relative_to(ROOT / 'docs')), source_sha256=sha(raw), archive_sha256=sha(packed), bytes=len(raw))
OUT.write_text(json.dumps(dict(state='original-main-preserved-and-selected-proof-passed', files=files,
                              original_main_head=before['main_head'], merged_gena_head=before['gena_head'],
                              original_cases=35740, current_cases=35764, original_reviews=519, current_reviews=520,
                              complete_prior_judgments_sources_metadata_reviews_unchanged=True,
                              complete_installed_main_input_identity=source_identity,
                              selected_controls=46, selected_files=len(selected['selected_files']),
                              original_failures_preserved=True,
                              producer=dict(text=Path(__file__).read_text(), sha256=sha(Path(__file__).read_bytes())),
                              scope='Main merge preparation and exact compile-input identity; fresh current main checks, full final-main Nix, quiet performance and contextual independent review remain separate.'), indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps(dict(files=len(files), manifest_sha256=sha(OUT.read_bytes()), complete_installed_main_input_identity=source_identity)))

scope: Main merge preparation and exact compile-input identity; fresh current main checks, full final-main Nix, quiet performance and contextual independent review remain separate.
